source_review: Entry is private and immutable; its OnceLock fragment is bound to the same raw TypedFunction and retained through Arc ownership. New/decoded entries start with empty slots. No cached Verified object is introduced.

Warm replay requires the complete Limits value to match, remaining cumulative node quota to fit and remaining wire bytes to fit. Otherwise the original function traversal runs, preserving first-failure diagnostics. Module, candidate and outer ZILFUN01 formats and limits remain unchanged.

FunctionSession clone/checkpoint share Arc<Mutex<()>> around complete encoding, closing simultaneous same-map retained-byte snapshot/admission races. Mutex poisoning recovers the guard; OnceLock only contains completed successful function fragments.

Whole cache publication borrows Entry functions instead of deep-cloning them into a temporary module; warm immutable fragments skip function encoding traversal. It still builds complete output buffers, copies wire bytes, hashes and writes/fsyncs full payloads.

Driver publication still follows successful finish_typed and rechecks cancellation, artifact aliases and directory admission. Optional cache failure cannot turn successful compilation into failure. Current independent Verify is unchanged.
function_cache_encoding is an opt-in final-attempt encoding-work counter. CompileReport starts it at None; restart constructs a new report. It is not a successful disk publication or Verify receipt.

Legacy byte equivalence, changed limits, exact/short node and byte quotas, partial function publication, edit/checkpoint/failed epoch/restore and shared eight-thread serialization tests have substantive assertions.

memory_limit.accepted_boundary: Current epoch admission subtracts bytes already retained by its selected slots, and each immutable Entry retains at most one fragment under one Limits value.
memory_limit.not_established: A strict max_source_bytes bound across all live checkpoints, epochs or session history; leak freedom or a measured memory improvement.
memory_limit.counterexample: An old checkpoint shares an unfilled Entry slot with a later epoch; after the later epoch drops other entries and fills this shared slot, the old checkpoint retained sum may exceed its earlier admission cap.
memory_limit.mitigation_and_scope: No unbounded internal history container was added. Driver keeps a checkpoint for its current transaction; arbitrary public snapshots retain their data. Root explicitly accepted this limit and declined a larger lifetime-budget registry. Source comments and pipeline audit disclose it.
memory_limit.wire_execution_limits: Strict current cumulative wire bytes/nodes remain enforced independently.

measurement_review: Six blocks, eight named-parent requests and three arms are sequential. Resident send-to-response and full Cargo process timings are explicitly different boundaries; startup/native execution/object inventory occur outside request timing.

Actual main source is pinned to 99035931d358add0eaed6d4535035c38413701dd. Compiler source identity rejects modified and untracked production paths; build receipts bind source/tree/binary hash/success/command. Compiler/tool/helper hashes are checked before and after.

Fixed workload is 20 modules x20 functions x16 steps; O2 requests use CGU16/jobs1 on each arm. Actual unit objects and symbol inventories are retained; requested CGU count does not establish partition equivalence.

Rust finalized-session selection uses unique new completed session relative to immediately prior inventory, or preserves prior current session when no new one appears. Historical objects are separate; ambiguity fails. This matches official pinned rustc GC retaining current and an older finalized session.

Exact error diagnostics, current Zil Verify counts, source/interface consistency and native output oracles are checked. Equal bytes alone are not counted as physical carry-forward or proof of skipped codegen.

Cargo profile/config/environment controls and verbose command evidence are retained. Unstable checksum freshness is not silently enabled. Root-only memory samples do not support cross-language process-tree memory comparisons.
No isolated attribution of main-to-candidate wall differences to this serialization slice is supported: those arms compare the complete research branch with main.
